Valid portable package/resources, no private-source leakage, mirror equality and governed repository publication.
Source-candidate status without untested activation, integration, outcome, holdout or uplift claims.

Available logs show manifest/registry passes, 174 AskJamie tests OK and latest catalog tests 51 passed/0 failed. Older catalog-integrity.log contains failures and is superseded only where later exact-scope receipts establish remediation; final-commit/remote gates remain below.

Current source-only candidate checks pass for both packages and mirror; privacy/path/JSON scrub passes. Catalog 51/0 and AskJamie 174-test results reconfirmed. This reviewer directly inspected the cited test logs but did not rerun source checks or independently compare private source.

negotiator.disagreement_resolution: Evidence review missing-run objection is met for final synthetic decision quality, not live completion. Safety objections are met at explicit-contract level and in R7/A7/A8 records, not enforced host behavior. Outcome reviewer usefulness judgment survives as a design interpretation, with no demonstrated uplift. Initial 0.1.0 runs/reviews remain historical and do not certify 0.2.0.
negotiator.strongest_surviving_objection: The control also passed every expectation. A single visible synthetic set cannot show that these skills add task quality or that prose ownership/retry controls work under real host/portal concurrency. Successful generated-material-to-submission/reconciliation and generic restore-to-completion flows remain untested.
negotiator.why_approval_survives: Public source candidates can expose concrete, composable contracts for bounded experimentation without asserting benefit or operational certification. Exact-byte integrity, explicit stop/stage boundaries and no observed synthetic critical failure meet that narrow purpose. Wider readiness remains deferred.
